Gorilla_Broad_Flat_Nose.description: This broad, flat nose, a hallmark of the primate lineage, enhances the creature's keen sense of smell and perception, allowing it to detect subtle scents and movements with uncanny accuracy, while also contributing to its robust constitution.

Proboscis_Monkey_Fleshy_Nose.description: This fleshy, vibrant nose, a hallmark of the proboscis monkey, serves as a beacon of charisma and an acute sensor of the world, enhancing both the wielder's charm and perceptiveness in the dense, perfumed jungles of the game world.

Baboon_Elongated_Snout.description: This elongated snout, a marvel of evolutionary adaptation, grants its bearer an unparalleled sense of smell and heightened perception, allowing them to detect even the faintest scents and subtle movements, while also bestowing a slight increase in physical strength, making it a formidable attribute in both combat and survival scenarios.

Lemur_Moist_Sniffing_Nose.description: This prehensile, elongated nose, highly attuned to the subtlest of scents, grants the lemur an unparalleled sense of perception and agility, allowing it to navigate the dense undergrowth with uncanny precision and detect potential threats or prey from afar.

Chimpanzee_Small_Nostrils.description: This diminutive primate component, marked by its unusually small nostrils, sharpens the senses and agility of its host, granting an enhanced alertness to subtle scents and movements, making it a precious asset in the murky realms of dark fantasy.

Mandrill_Brightly_Colored_Snout.description: The brightly colored snout of the mandrill, a flamboyant and captivating cephalic feature, enhances the primate’s innate charisma and sharpens its senses, making it a master of both allure and awareness in the dense, vibrant jungles.

Spectral_Ape_Ghostly_Nares.description: The spectral ape's ghostly nares, a haunting relic of its once-living form, possess an uncanny ability to detect even the faintest traces of magic and hidden threats, its heightened perception and wisdom granting it an eerie awareness beyond the veil of life.

Zombie_Primate_Rotting_Snout.description: The Zombie Primate Rotting Snout is a ghastly creature with a distorted, decayed face, where its once-sensitive nose now serves as a conduit for detecting the faintest traces of living flesh, its keen scent guiding it through the darkest of necrotic landscapes.

Tarsier_Tiny_Twitching_Nose.description: This diminutive, twitching nose, a marvel of primate evolution, enhances the bearer's sensory perception and agility, allowing them to detect the faintest scents and slip through the shadows with unparalleled grace.

Orangutan_Mottled_Nose_Pads.description: The mottled nose pads of the orangutan are a masterpiece of evolutionary adaptation, enhancing the primate's keen senses and wisdom, allowing it to navigate the dense, treacherous jungles with unmatched perception and awareness.
